editorial:
Imagine you are a regular guy working at a record store, but your whole life revolves around one famous actress. You have her photos everywhere and you know every role she has ever played. That is exactly where you start with this movie. It kicks off as a simple story about a huge fan, but things get creepy very fast. The vibe is tense and uncomfortable because you can see the main character losing his grip on reality. He believes he and the actress are meant to be together, but when she does not feel the same way, his love turns into a dangerous obsession that puts everyone around her in danger.

What really works here is how the tension builds up slowly until it finally snaps. The acting is solid and makes you feel sorry for the actress as her life turns into a nightmare. Some parts move a bit slow, but the scary moments make up for it. If you love old-school thrillers, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a final, violent showdown between the obsessed fan and the actress. After stalking her for so long, he finally corners her, believing that if he cannot have her, no one can. In a desperate struggle, the actress manages to fight back and kill him to save herself. It wraps up with a grim reminder that some people can never be reasoned with and that obsession only leads to a dead end.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves vintage stalker movies and psychological thrillers.
